§6Renewable Generators§f

§aClean, passive power. No fuel, no fuss.§f

Industrial Renewal gives you several ways to generate energy without burning through coal reserves.

§bSolar Panel§f: Generates §e15 FE/t§f in direct sunlight. Drop it inside a §bSolar Frame§f and output doubles to §e30 FE/t§f. Simple and reliable.

§bSmall Wind Turbine§f: Needs a Wind Blade item installed by right-clicking. Generates up to §e128 FE/t§f. Output depends on weather and height, with rain giving the best performance. Blades wear out over time, so keep spares.

§bDam Generator§f: A multiblock that outputs a solid §e1,024 FE/t§f from flowing water. Build it between dam intake and outflow blocks with water streaming through.

§bPortable Generator§f: Burns solid fuels for §e32 FE/t§f with a §e16,000 FE§f internal buffer. Good for powering field equipment or remote mining drills.

§ePS:§f The wind turbine's output barely changes with height. Weather is the bigger factor.
